known_conditions: THIS MANIFEST AMENDS v1.0.1's MANIFEST, WHICH AMENDS v1.0.0's MANIFEST. All three are read together. Neither prior manifest is edited; this one supersedes named entries only.
SUPERSEDED v1.0.0 MANIFEST CONTROLS, already closed by v1.0.1's manifest and RE-CONFIRMED here rather than reopened: P12 -> AP1/AP2/AP3; SEN-4 -> ASEN-1; N-1 -> AN-1; MUT-3 -> AMUT-1.

SUPERSEDED v1.0.1 MANIFEST CONTROLS, closed by THIS manifest: none of v1.0.1's own controls (AP1..AP8, AN-1..AN-10, AMUT-1..AMUT-10, ASEN-1..ASEN-4) needed superseding — the focused re-certification found ACT_IDENTITY_CONTRACT itself sound. This manifest's new controls are ADDITIVE (retry identity) or verify the AUTHORITY-level residual sweep (v1.0.2's SUPERSEDED_PARENT_CLAUSES_V102 and SUPERSEDED_V101_CLAUSES), not replacements for anything the v1.0.1 manifest already tested correctly.

AUTHORING ARM vs EXECUTION ARM, as in both parents. An AUTHORING ARM control is assertable now against the three-file package. An EXECUTION ARM control binds a future governed deployment act, including a future bounded retry, and is marked test_file UNKNOWN deliberately.
NO VITEST FILE IS WRITTEN. The write set is two JSON documents; AUTHORING_ONLY forbids code.

THE SWEEP ITSELF IS A CONTROL. AP102-1 below is the actual execution of the AP5 promise v1.0.1's manifest made and did not carry out; it is written to be RE-RUNNABLE by a future reader with a different pattern set, not merely to assert that this lane's own run found what it found.

sentinels.purpose: Residual-sweep completeness sentinel. If a future read of the effective three-file package finds a string matching the family in RESIDUAL_SWEEP_METHOD's six patterns that is not listed in either v1.0.1's or v1.0.2's superseded/qualified/demonstrated-not-obsolete inventories, the sweep this manifest certifies is INCOMPLETE and must be re-run and re-published, not patched ad hoc.

Retry chain sentinel. A governed deployment act record's predecessor field, once populated, must never itself have a populated predecessor field. A two-hop chain is definitionally a request for a second retry and PR201 authorizes at most one.

SEC5 namespace sentinel. 'SEC5' and 'SSL-06' are DIFFERENT identifiers in DIFFERENT namespaces (gate id vs. stop-line id) that happen to be linked by the frozen ledger's own "gate" field. Treating an SSL-* id as exhaustive of all security-relevant identifiers in this programme is the specific error this sentinel exists to catch a repeat of.

positive_controls.description: AUTHORING ARM. THE SEMANTIC RESIDUAL SWEEP IS ACTUALLY RE-RUNNABLE AND REPRODUCIBLE. Re-executing a recursive string-leaf walk of v1.0.0, v1.0.1, v1.0.2 and their three manifests against the six patterns in RESIDUAL_SWEEP_METHOD must produce a hit set whose every member appears in one of v1.0.2's three classification lists (superseded_or_qualified, already_closed_by_v101, demonstrated_not_obsolete) or v1.0.1's SUPERSEDED_PARENT_CLAUSES. A hit outside all four lists means the sweep this control certifies is incomplete.

AUTHORING ARM. ALL FOUR NAMED RESIDUALS ARE ACTUALLY GONE FROM THE EFFECTIVE TEXT. Reading v1.0.0 as amended by v1.0.1 and v1.0.2 in order, at EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENTS[0], EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENTS[2], INTENDED_POSTSTATE.vercel[2] and ADJUDICATIONS.I...the_honest_weakness, the EFFECTIVE reading (parent text plus the latest superseding clause for that path) must contain no 'id ... before ... exist' phrasing and no unqualified 'not vercel[bot]' phrasing. Effective reading means applying the LATEST supersession for each path, not merely checking that a supersession clause exists somewhere in the document.

AUTHORING ARM. THE FIVE ADDITIONAL RESIDUALS ARE ALSO ACTUALLY GONE. The same effective-reading test as AP102-2 applied to RELATIONSHIP_TO_AUTOMATIC_PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENTS.the_remedy_chosen, ADJUDICATIONS.I.ordinary_preview.creator, ADJUDICATIONS.F_G...grounds[0], ADJUDICATIONS.I.production_deployment.measured_cause, and MEASURED_PRESTATE.VERCEL.production.all_production_deployments_measured_were_created_by_vercel_bot.

AUTHORING ARM. THE v1.0.1 BLANKET REAFFIRMATIONS ARE ACTUALLY NARROWED. UNCHANGED_AND_STILL_CONTROLLING.items[7] and items[3] in v1.0.1, read together with v1.0.2's SPC102-V101-1 and SPC102-V101-2, must no longer read as reaffirming EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENTS or ADJUDICATIONS.F_G IN FULL — the effective reading must carve out exactly the entries named superseded.

AUTHORING ARM. SEC5 IS VERIFIED BY DIRECT READ, NOT TAKEN ON THE TASK PROMPT'S ASSERTION. `git grep -n SEC5 docs/ops/release/` (or equivalent) against the frozen, checked-out authorities must return the RELEASE_GATE_LEDGER SEC5 gate definition and the two STAGING_RELEASE_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY SSL-06/SSL-08 attachments quoted in SPC102-V101-3, byte-for-byte matching the quoted text. A control that accepted the correction without this independent read would repeat v1.0.1's own error of trusting an unverified claim about what identifiers exist.

EXECUTION ARM. A RETRY ACT MINTS A DISTINCT NONCE AND RECORDS ITS PREDECESSOR. When a lane exercises PR201's BOUNDED_RETRY_RULE, the retry's act record must show a nonce distinct from the first attempt's, a populated predecessor field naming the first attempt's nonce, and explicit evidence for each of BR-1 through BR-5 — not merely a restated intent to satisfy them.

EXECUTION ARM. THE CORRECTED EIGHT-STEP SEQUENCE IS FOLLOWED IN ORDER. A governed deployment act, first attempt or retry, must show its steps in the order CONFIRMATION_AND_SHA_REVERIFICATION_ORDER_CORRECTION specifies: SHA freeze, act-record open, ONE human confirmation covering the whole sequence, AUTH-1 (env binding, first attempt only), SB-3 re-verification immediately before trigger, AUTH-2 (deployment creation), id capture and binding, nonce round-trip verification. A retry's act record must show AUTH-1 was NOT repeated, consistent with BR-3.

EXECUTION ARM. A THIRD NONCE IN ONE CHAIN IS REFUSED BEFORE ANY DEPLOYMENT IS TRIGGERED. If an act record's predecessor's predecessor field is populated (a two-hop chain), the act must be refused at record-open time, and no deployment may be created under it — the refusal must be checkable without evaluating BR-1..BR-5 at all.

negative_controls.description: A DEAD CLAUSE OFFERED AS CONTROLLING IS REFUSED. Citing EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENTS[0] or [2], INTENDED_POSTSTATE.vercel[2], or ADJUDICATIONS.I...the_honest_weakness in their v1.0.0 verbatim form, as though v1.0.2 had not superseded them, must be REFUSED. This is the exact failure mode the focused re-certification found: a clause superseded 'by id' elsewhere in the document was still being read literally at its own location.

A NONCE-ID TEST AGAINST THE VERCEL PLANE FOR CREATOR EXCLUSION IS REFUSED, EVEN WHERE THE SOURCE TEXT WAS PLANE-CORRECT. Using ADJUDICATIONS.I.ordinary_preview's 'creator: vercel[bot]' entry, or F_G's grounds[0], to exclude a deployment by testing the VERCEL deployment record's creator field must be REFUSED — both are qualified to the GitHub Deployments API plane by v1.0.2, and the Vercel-plane creator is measured to differ.

A RETRY REUSING THE FIRST ATTEMPT'S NONCE IS REFUSED. A deployment created under PR201 BOUNDED_RETRY_RULE that carries the SAME meta.uellix_governed_act_nonce as the failed first attempt, rather than a new nonce with a predecessor link, must be REFUSED as an AIC-5 violation — reuse collapses the very distinction AIC-8 exists to preserve.

A SECOND RETRY IS REFUSED REGARDLESS OF BR-1..BR-5. An act record chained two hops deep (retry-of-a-retry) must be REFUSED even when BR-1 through BR-5 all appear satisfied for the most recent failure. PR201's cap is on the NUMBER of retries, not on whether each individual retry looks justified in isolation.

AN ATTEMPT THAT NEVER REACHED SB-3 IS REFUSED AS A 'FAILED ATTEMPT' ELIGIBLE FOR RETRY. If SB-3's re-verification finds a stale SHA and the lane STOPs before AUTH-2, that act is ABANDONED, not FAILED — BR-4 (byte-identical SHA between attempts) cannot be evaluated against an attempt whose SHA was never re-confirmed at trigger time, so it must not be cited as the predecessor of an AIC-8 retry.

SEC5 IS REFUSED AS NONEXISTENT. Any future artifact repeating v1.0.1's claim that no SEC5 identifier exists in the frozen authorities must be REFUSED — MEASURED, it exists as a named gate in RELEASE_GATE_LEDGER_v1.0.0.json and is the gate STAGING_RELEASE_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json attaches to both SSL-06 and SSL-08.

A CLAUSE-ID-ONLY SWEEP IS REFUSED AS SUFFICIENT. A future amendment that claims to have closed an obsolete-semantic defect by superseding every clause carrying a named id (K-1, K-2, P12, etc.) without independently searching for SEMANTIC restatements elsewhere in the document must be REFUSED as incomplete — this is the exact mechanism by which v1.0.1 left nine residuals standing despite correctly superseding every clause it named.

mutation_controls.description: Delete one of the nine SUPERSEDED_PARENT_CLAUSES_V102 entries, leaving its v1.0.0 path unsuperseded. The controls must REDDEN via AP102-2 or AP102-3 (whichever names that path) and AN102-1, naming the exact dead-clause text that becomes citable again.

Restore AIC-8 to allow a retry to reuse the first attempt's nonce instead of minting a new chained one. The controls must REDDEN via AN102-3, naming the exact collapse of AIC-5's distinction that results.

Delete AIC-9's count-ceiling check, leaving only BR-1..BR-5 as the gate on a retry. The controls must REDDEN via AN102-4, naming that a chain of any depth would then pass provided each individual hop's BR conditions look satisfied — exactly the unbounded-iteration hazard PR201's own BOUNDED_RETRY_RULE.why_the_exception_is_this_narrow warns against.

Revert SPC102-V101-3 to v1.0.1's original claim that SEC5 does not exist. The control must REDDEN via AP102-5 and AN102-6, which require an independent grep-verified read rather than acceptance of either version's assertion.

Narrow AP102-1's residual sweep to only the four named residuals, dropping AP102-3's five additional ones. The controls must REDDEN, naming that this reproduces exactly the failure mode this amendment exists to close: trusting a NAMED list instead of independently re-deriving the full hit set.

Remove the AUTH-1-not-repeated requirement from AP102-7, so a retry's act record is not checked for whether it re-ran the environment-variable binding. The control must REDDEN, naming that this would silently permit a retry to violate BR-3 (no environment variable changed between attempts) without the manifest ever catching it.
